title: Rigoberta Menchú
summary: Rigoberta Menchú is a K'iche' Maya human rights activist who gained international attention through her autobiographical testimony documenting military violence and indigenous oppression during the Guatemalan Civil War. Awarded the 1992 Nobel Peace Prize for her advocacy of social justice and ethnic reconciliation, she became an influential global voice for indigenous rights and cultural preservation.

as_recorded.value: recipient of the 1992 Nobel peace prize

importance.justification: First indigenous person to receive the Nobel Peace Prize, bringing global recognition to indigenous rights and crimes during Guatemala's civil war.
